# Wrapper

`layout/wrapper` &middot; section-level &middot; category: layout

## Purpose

Groups several sections inside one background, border or frame.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | components (section-level) |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Framed on the page background color.
- **card**: Bordered, rounded frame from the theme card style. Sets `background: @theme.card.background`, `border: @theme.card.borderWidth solid @theme.card.border`, `radius: @theme.card.radius`, `shadow: @theme.card.shadow`, `padding: @theme.card.padding`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.background"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.md"` |
| `width` | one of `constrained`, `full` | `"constrained"` |
| `border` | text | `"none"` |
| `radius` | length | `"0"` |
| `shadow` | one of `none`, `small`, `medium`, `large` | `"none"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Background and padding honored. Border radius and shadows are ignored. | Fine. | Swaps only when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('layout/wrapper', {
  "content": [
    {
      "component": "layout/section",
      "data": {
        "content": [
          {
            "component": "content/heading",
            "data": {
              "text": "Your order is on its way"
            },
            "settings": {
              "level": "h3"
            }
          },
          {
            "component": "content/text",
            "data": {
              "text": "Estimated delivery: Thursday, 4 June."
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "component": "layout/section",
      "data": {
        "content": [
          {
            "component": "content/button",
            "data": {
              "label": "Track your package",
              "href": "https://example.com/orders/1042"
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```
